literal: Possessor of humility, speaker of sweet words being, to a person ornament; are not besides other things.
translation: Being humble and speaking sweet words are the true ornaments for a person; all other things are not.
modern: ஒருவருக்கு உண்மையான அணிகலன்கள் பணிவுடையவராகவும் இனிய சொற்களைப் பேசுபவராகவும் இருப்பதே ஆகும்; மற்றவை எல்லாம் அணிகலன்கள் ஆகா.
explanation: This couplet defines the true adornment for any individual. It states that possessing humility and speaking sweet words are the only real ornaments for a person. The phrase 'மற்றுப் பிற' (all other things) combined with 'அல்ல' (are not) dismisses physical jewelry or external decorations as false ornaments. The word 'ஆதல்' (being) emphasizes that these are internal qualities one must embody, rather than external objects one wears.
